chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man upon whom multiple hudud had become due, among them execution, he said: “One begins with the hudud that are less than execution, then he is executed afterward.”

key_terms.الْقَتْلُ: execution or killing as a legal punishment
key_terms.حُدُودٌ: prescribed legal punishments established in the Sacred Law
key_terms.دُونَ: less than; below the level of
key_terms.يُبْدَأُ: it is begun; priority is given first

ai.seo_question: If a person is subject to multiple hudud including execution, which punishment is carried out first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person liable to multiple prescribed punishments, including one that entails execution. It states that the punishments short of execution are carried out first, and then execution is performed afterward.
